title: buildRecordIndex
description: The app's index of a product's space: the record summaries' records by ID, their children and their links both ways, and the domains, with each record's problems (LA-CHK-RM01), its gaps and the coverage (LA-TRC-RM01), the folder tree (LA-EXP-RM02) and the meta model (LA-PLT-RM08) beside them. Built by layer, each when its own read changes, the records worked out again only for what changed since the last answer; the nav, the pages and the stages read it, and it renders nothing.
